article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Kendall Munson's 17 points helped Jacksonville defeat Stetson 79-72 on Wednesday night. Munson added eight rebounds for the Dolphins (18-12, 12-6 Atlantic Sun Conference). Chris Arias scored 14 points, going 5 of 10 (4 for 7 from 3-point range). Jakari Spence shot 2 of 6 from the field and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Jamie Phillips Jr. helped lead the way for the Hatters (8-23, 6-12) with 20 points, six rebounds and two steals. Mehki added 20 points, six rebounds and three steals for Stetson. Josh Massey also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
